data.name: Sanyog
data.gender_notes: Sanyog is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sanyog is a Sanskrit and Hindi name for a boy, derived from the Sanskrit word 'sanyoga', meaning 'connection' or 'union'. It is a name that evokes feelings of the divine and the profound, suggesting a deep sense of spiritual connection and unity with all things. The name Sanyog carries the meaning “Connection, Union, Divine” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sanyog usually hope their child will grow to embody connection, union, divine and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the coming together of two entities, be it two souls, two elements, or two aspects of oneself. It represents the union of opposites, the harmony of contrasts, and the interconnectedness of all things. It is a powerful name for those seeking spiritual growth and enlightenment, as it reminds us of the underlying unity and interconnectedness of all things.
data.etymology: Sanyog belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Connection, Union, Divine.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sanyog total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
